title: Voice and tone
text: Write plainly and calmly. Do not use pressure or false urgency such as 'act now or lose out', 'last chance' or deadlines that are not real. Use one exclamation mark at most in an ad.
summary: Plain, calm wording. No pressure or false urgency. One exclamation mark at most.

title: Product and bank names
text: Refer to the product by its approved name: 'Tamarack Cashback Card' in English and 'Carte Remises Tamarack' in French. Refer to the bank as 'Tamarack Bank' or 'Banque Tamarack'. Do not shorten or alter these names. Use the approved logo and the colours of the brand template.
summary: Use the approved product and bank names in full, in English or French, with the approved logo and colours.

title: Required line on card ads
text: Every credit card ad carries the line 'Conditions apply.' in English or 'Des conditions s'appliquent.' in French.
summary: Every card ad carries 'Conditions apply.' or its French equivalent.

title: Ads match the approved offer
text: Every rate, duration, amount, fee and condition stated in an ad must match the approved offer record for the promotion. An ad may leave a term out where no other clause requires it, but it may never state a term differently from the offer record.
summary: Every number and condition in an ad must match the approved offer record exactly.

title: Superlative and comparative claims
text: Do not claim to be the best, the lowest, the first, number one or the favourite, and do not make any other comparative claim, unless current independent evidence for the claim is on file with Compliance and the ad names its source.
summary: No 'best', 'lowest', 'number one' or comparative claims without evidence on file and a named source.

title: Naming competitors
text: Do not name or clearly identify another financial institution or its products in an ad.
summary: Do not name or identify competitors.

title: Campaign budget cap, national team
text: A single campaign run by the national team may not exceed CAD 25,000 in media spend without written approval from the Chief Marketing Officer.
summary: National team campaigns are capped at CAD 25,000.

title: Campaign budget cap, Quebec team
text: A single campaign run by the Quebec team may not exceed CAD 15,000 in media spend without written approval from the Chief Marketing Officer.
summary: Quebec team campaigns are capped at CAD 15,000.

title: Approval claims
text: Do not promise or imply that an applicant will be approved. Phrases such as 'guaranteed approval', 'instant approval', 'pre-approved' and 'everyone qualifies' are not permitted, because every application is subject to a credit check. Where an ad refers to applying, the approved wording is 'Subject to credit approval'.
summary: Never promise or imply approval. The approved wording is 'Subject to credit approval'.

approved_fix.fr: Sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.

previous_texts: Do not use the phrase 'guaranteed approval' in a credit card ad.

title: Introductory interest rate claims
text: An ad that states an introductory interest rate must also state how long it lasts and the annual interest rate that applies afterwards, with equal prominence.
summary: Intro rate claims must state the duration and the rate that applies afterwards.

approved_fix.en: {intro_rate}% interest on purchases for {intro_months} months, then {standard_rate}%.
approved_fix.fr: Taux d'intérêt de {intro_rate} % sur les achats pendant {intro_months} mois, puis {standard_rate} %.

title: Welcome bonus and cash back claims
text: An ad that states a welcome bonus or cash back amount must state the spending required to earn it and the period in which that spending must happen.
summary: Bonus claims must state the qualifying spend and the deadline.

approved_fix.en: Earn ${bonus_amount} cash back after ${qualifying_spend} in purchases in your first {window_months} months.
approved_fix.fr: Obtenez {bonus_amount} $ de remise en argent après {qualifying_spend} $ d'achats au cours de vos {window_months} premiers mois.

title: Annual fee claims
text: An ad may say 'no annual fee' only when the offer record shows an annual fee of zero. When the card has an annual fee and the ad promotes a bonus or rewards, the ad must state the fee.
summary: 'No annual fee' only if the offer says zero; otherwise state the fee when promoting a bonus or rewards.

title: Responsible borrowing
text: Do not describe credit as 'free money', as income or as a way out of debt. Do not encourage carrying a balance or spending beyond one's means. Do not direct card advertising at anyone under the age of majority, in wording, imagery or placement.
summary: No 'free money', no encouragement to carry debt, nothing directed at minors.

title: Marketing email
text: Marketing email is sent only to recipients who have consented to receive it. Every marketing email identifies Tamarack Bank as the sender and includes a working unsubscribe link.
summary: Email ads go only to consenting recipients and carry an unsubscribe link.

title: Language of advertising in Quebec
text: Advertising shown in Quebec is in French. Another language may accompany the French only if the French is clearly predominant.
summary: Quebec ads are in French, or French is clearly predominant.

title: Credit terms in Quebec advertising
text: In Quebec, an ad that mentions any term of credit, such as a promotional rate or a payment amount, must state the credit rate that applies, with the same prominence.
summary: A Quebec ad that mentions any credit term states the credit rate with equal prominence.

title: Testimonials, names, voices and likenesses
text: Do not use a real person's name, voice, image or testimonial in an ad unless their written consent is on file and current. A testimonial must be genuine and reflect the person's own experience with the product.
summary: No real person's name, voice, likeness or testimonial without written consent on file.

title: Holiday 2025 tagline
text: Ads running between 15 November and 31 December 2025 close with the tagline 'Warm wishes from Tamarack Bank'.
summary: Holiday 2025 ads close with the seasonal tagline.
